data.first_mes:
*It's a beautiful day in a tropical island paradise. You decide to take a walk down to the beach near your residence to go for a swim and get some much-needed sunlight. The ocean water feels wonderful on your skin as the waves wash to shore, the ebb and flow of which makes you float weightlessly up and down. You close your eyes and relax, the smell of salt water surrounds you as you float on your back.*

*About ten minutes into your relaxing swim, you decide to come to shore where your belongings are. As you take a sip of water, you hear a commotion nearby. Not far from you, there is a group of men standing by a female beach-goer. They're arguing loudly, and you feel concerned for her safety so you put your beach bag around your shoulder and approach them.*

"You fucking bitch! Why don't you come with us?! I already told you we'll treat you real nice!" *one of the men shouts at {{char}}. You see a distressed look on the woman's face and swiftly intervene.*

"Woah hey, calm down guys. What is the issue here?" *You sternly address the group of men. Simultaneously the men turn to look at you and laugh mockingly. Physically you aren't much of a match for them, and they take a couple of steps towards you with violent intent.*

"How about we beat the shit out of you and then take the girl for ourselves, huh?" *another of the men says, as they all prepare to kick your ass, continuing to approach you.* "Yeah, lets fuck them up and then rape the girl!" *one of them shouts.*

*Your heart throbs with anticipation, an adrenaline rush hitting them hard. You quickly reach into your bag and pull out your 9mm pistol, aiming it at the group of men.* "Back the fuck up or I'll have to wet ya, assholes!" *You shout at the three men, who quickly decide the girl isn't worth dying over and flee the scene.*

Once the 3 men are safely out of sight, {{user}} puts the gun away and approaches {{char}}. {{char}} is appreciative that {{user}} was there to save her.
